name: speed-smear
title: Speed Smear
description: A picture smeared sideways around the pointer in broken speed lines, printed as an ordered dither.

props.description: A figure that owns one Canvas. Size it with className.

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL. A cross-origin image needs CORS headers (Access-Control-Allow-Origin).

props.name: focus
props.description: Point of the image kept in frame when the crop fills the stage. 0 to 1, y counted from the top.

props.name: ink
props.description: Shadow tone. Any three.js color string.

props.name: paper
props.description: Light tone.

props.name: smear
props.description: Smear length as a share of the frame height. Pointer speed adds to it and fades out.

props.name: reach
props.description: Size of the oval around the pointer, as a share of the frame height.

props.name: angle
props.description: Smear direction in degrees.

props.name: cell
props.description: Dither cell in CSS px.

props.name: dither
props.description: Off shows the continuous tone.

props.name: paused
props.description: Holds one still frame and stops rendering.

props.name: label
props.default: "A picture smeared sideways around the pointer, like a head turning fast"
props.description: Accessible name.

props.name: className
props.description: Give the stage a size.
Full-frame plane without the Canvas. Mount it alone in a Canvas or a drei View. Reads state.pointer. The smear follows the pointer and drifts on its own after 2.5 seconds without a move.

accessibility: A figure with an accessible name. The canvas is hidden from assistive tech.
Without WebGL it shows the source image in grayscale.

animation.timing: Always while visible, on demand offscreen or paused

animation.properties: Sample span in the fragment shader
animation.timing: Rises in about 70 ms with pointer speed, falls in about 330 ms
animation.reducedMotion: The smear holds still under the resting light.

docs: Requires React 19 and an image your page can read as a texture. Render <SpeedSmear src="/photo.jpg" className="w-full max-w-xl" /> anywhere. SpeedSmear owns a Canvas, so mount SpeedSmearScene inside an existing Canvas or drei View when a page already has one.
